scope: Close, offer/application scope and transport invalidation
Rust application_json field normalization after read-only polling
Focused raw GET and claimed-during-pending-handoff regression assertions
resolvedFindings: The real OID4VCIInviteDisplay previously navigated after stale awaited registry results. Commit 0943e11 applies the shared guarded opener to the actual child and disables its pending open button.
The mobile parent previously selected response.open_uri directly and could lose the existing browser-wallet fallback. It now uses the same shared chooser through the hook.

Raw GET application_json has offer_expires_at and credential_offer_uri, unlike normalized initial claim responses. Shared normalizeApplicationOffer now normalizes both paths; alias writes follow the raw-data spread.
validationBoundary: This review reads source and focused regression assertions. It does not claim parent test execution; the root owner performs the final parent test run. Real-child execution is separately recorded in ui-wallet-open-handoff.json.
